title: LLM
description: GPU, model switcher queue, vLLM and LiteLLM metrics. The model filter applies to vLLM. Latency metrics appear after requests; missing latency data is not replaced with zero.

panels.description: Whether Prometheus successfully scraped vLLM at the selected range end. Up means the metrics endpoint responded; it does not confirm that inference requests can complete.
Whether Prometheus successfully scraped LiteLLM at the selected range end. Up means the metrics endpoint responded; it does not confirm that upstream models or client requests are working.

Whether Prometheus scraped the queue exporter and that exporter successfully read the model switcher status at the selected range end. Up confirms collection of queue status, not successful inference.

Whether GPU collection succeeded and its latest sample is less than 60 seconds old at the selected range end. Down means collection failed or became stale; it does not alone establish a GPU hardware failure.

panels.title: Model switcher · Queue and active model
Running and waiting requests
panels.description: Number of requests running or waiting in the model switcher, upstream of vLLM. Running includes model startup, so it can differ from requests executing inside vLLM. A growing waiting count means requests are accumulating before reaching the model engine.

panels.title: Last confirmed loaded model
panels.description: A value of 1 identifies the last model the switcher confirmed as loaded. This records model selection over time; it does not continuously verify vLLM readiness or show how many requests are running.

panels.title: GPU temperature
panels.description: GPU temperature in degrees Celsius, as reported by the driver. Rising temperature shows increased thermal load. Only successful samples less than 60 seconds old are shown; unavailable or stale readings are omitted, not replaced with zero.

targets.expr: avg by (instance, uuid, name, index) ((socrat_gpu_temperature_celsius and on(instance) (socrat_gpu_collection_success == 1)) and on(instance) ((time() - socrat_gpu_collection_timestamp_seconds) < 60))

panels.title: GPU and memory controller utilization
panels.description: GPU execution and memory-controller activity as percentages of the driver sampling interval. Memory-controller utilization measures activity, not the fraction of VRAM occupied. Only successful GPU samples less than 60 seconds old are shown.

targets.expr: avg by (instance, uuid, name, index) ((socrat_gpu_utilization_ratio and on(instance) (socrat_gpu_collection_success == 1)) and on(instance) ((time() - socrat_gpu_collection_timestamp_seconds) < 60))

avg by (instance, uuid, name, index) ((socrat_gpu_memory_utilization_ratio and on(instance) (socrat_gpu_collection_success == 1)) and on(instance) ((time() - socrat_gpu_collection_timestamp_seconds) < 60))

panels.title: GPU memory · Used and total
panels.description: GPU memory currently allocated and total GPU memory, in byte-based units. A small gap means little unallocated VRAM remains, though some allocation may be reserved caches. Only successful samples less than 60 seconds old are shown.

targets.expr: avg by (instance, uuid, name, index) ((socrat_gpu_memory_used_bytes and on(instance) (socrat_gpu_collection_success == 1)) and on(instance) ((time() - socrat_gpu_collection_timestamp_seconds) < 60))
avg by (instance, uuid, name, index) ((socrat_gpu_memory_total_bytes and on(instance) (socrat_gpu_collection_success == 1)) and on(instance) ((time() - socrat_gpu_collection_timestamp_seconds) < 60))

panels.title: GPU memory utilization
panels.description: Allocated GPU memory as a percentage of total VRAM. This measures capacity use, not GPU computation or memory-controller activity. Only successful samples less than 60 seconds old are shown.

targets.expr: avg by (instance, uuid, name, index) ((socrat_gpu_memory_used_bytes / socrat_gpu_memory_total_bytes and on(instance) (socrat_gpu_collection_success == 1)) and on(instance) ((time() - socrat_gpu_collection_timestamp_seconds) < 60))

panels.title: Power draw and limit
panels.description: GPU power draw and configured power limit, in watts. Draw near the limit can constrain clock speed under load; check throttling reasons alongside it. Only successful samples less than 60 seconds old are shown.

targets.expr: avg by (instance, uuid, name, index) ((socrat_gpu_power_watts and on(instance) (socrat_gpu_collection_success == 1)) and on(instance) ((time() - socrat_gpu_collection_timestamp_seconds) < 60))
avg by (instance, uuid, name, index) ((socrat_gpu_power_limit_watts and on(instance) (socrat_gpu_collection_success == 1)) and on(instance) ((time() - socrat_gpu_collection_timestamp_seconds) < 60))

panels.title: Fan speed
panels.description: GPU fan speed as a percentage of the driver-reported maximum. It is not a temperature or RPM reading; fans may stop at idle. Unsupported readings are omitted, and only successful samples less than 60 seconds old are shown.

targets.expr: avg by (instance, uuid, name, index) ((socrat_gpu_fan_speed_ratio and on(instance) (socrat_gpu_collection_success == 1)) and on(instance) ((time() - socrat_gpu_collection_timestamp_seconds) < 60))

panels.title: GPU and memory clock speeds
panels.description: GPU graphics and memory clock frequencies, shown in frequency units. Clocks vary with workload and power management, so lower clocks at idle are expected. Only successful samples less than 60 seconds old are shown.

targets.expr: avg by (instance, uuid, name, index) ((socrat_gpu_clock_graphics_hertz and on(instance) (socrat_gpu_collection_success == 1)) and on(instance) ((time() - socrat_gpu_collection_timestamp_seconds) < 60))
avg by (instance, uuid, name, index) ((socrat_gpu_clock_memory_hertz and on(instance) (socrat_gpu_collection_success == 1)) and on(instance) ((time() - socrat_gpu_collection_timestamp_seconds) < 60))

panels.title: GPU performance state
panels.description: Driver-reported GPU performance state: P0 is the highest-performance state, and higher numbers generally represent lower-performance power-saving states. Idle changes are expected. Only successful samples less than 60 seconds old are shown.

targets.expr: avg by (instance, uuid, name, index) ((socrat_gpu_performance_state and on(instance) (socrat_gpu_collection_success == 1)) and on(instance) ((time() - socrat_gpu_collection_timestamp_seconds) < 60))

panels.title: Clock throttling reasons
panels.description: Driver-reported reasons for limiting GPU clocks: 1 means a reason is active, 0 means inactive. Idle is normal when there is no work; power or thermal reasons need workload context. Only successful samples less than 60 seconds old are shown.

targets.expr: max by (instance, uuid, name, index, reason) ((socrat_gpu_throttle_active and on(instance) (socrat_gpu_collection_success == 1)) and on(instance) ((time() - socrat_gpu_collection_timestamp_seconds) < 60))

panels.title: GPU collection age
panels.description: Seconds since the timestamp reported by the GPU collector. Other GPU panels hide readings when collection fails or this age reaches 60 seconds. Age alone does not prove success; check the GPU collection status as well.

panels.title: vLLM · Requests, tokens and KV cache
vLLM requests · Running and waiting
panels.description: Number of requests executing or waiting inside vLLM for each selected model. This is separate from the upstream switcher queue. Persistent waiting with running requests can indicate that demand exceeds the engine capacity.

panels.title: KV cache utilization
panels.description: Percentage of the vLLM key/value cache currently occupied for each selected model. This cache stores attention state used during generation; it is only part of total GPU memory. Higher values mean less cache capacity remains.

panels.title: Token throughput
panels.description: Input prompt and generated output tokens per second for each selected model, averaged over the automatic rate interval. This is aggregate engine throughput, not the speed of an individual response.

panels.title: Request completions by reason
panels.description: Requests finishing per second in vLLM, grouped by selected model and completion reason, averaged over the automatic rate interval. The source counter includes abort and error outcomes as well as normal completions; the metric name does not imply all requests succeeded.

panels.title: Prefix cache hit ratio
panels.description: Percentage of queried prefix-cache tokens served from the cache during the entire selected time range, by selected model. Higher values mean more previously processed prompt content was reused. Without cache queries, the ratio is undefined and no estimate is shown.

panels.title: KV cache request preemptions
panels.description: vLLM request preemptions per second, averaged over the automatic rate interval. Preemption pauses work when cache capacity is needed elsewhere and can increase latency; it is not itself a failed request.

panels.title: Time to first token
panels.description: Time from a request entering vLLM until its first output token, in seconds. Shows estimated p50 (median) and p95 (95% of observations at or below this value) for each selected model over the entire selected time range. Higher values mean longer waits. No observations means no latency estimate, not zero.

panels.title: End-to-end request latency
panels.description: Time for a full request to complete inside vLLM, in seconds. Shows estimated p50 (median) and p95 (95% of observations at or below this value) for each selected model over the entire selected time range. Higher values mean longer waits. No observations means no latency estimate, not zero.

panels.title: Inter-token latency
panels.description: Time between generated output tokens inside vLLM, in seconds. Shows estimated p50 (median) and p95 (95% of observations at or below this value) for each selected model over the entire selected time range. Higher values mean longer waits. No observations means no latency estimate, not zero.

panels.title: Queue wait
panels.description: Time a request waits in the internal vLLM queue before execution, excluding the upstream switcher queue, in seconds. Shows estimated p50 (median) and p95 (95% of observations at or below this value) for each selected model over the entire selected time range. Higher values mean longer waits. No observations means no latency estimate, not zero.

panels.title: Input processing
panels.description: Time vLLM spends processing the input prompt before generating the response, in seconds. Shows estimated p50 (median) and p95 (95% of observations at or below this value) for each selected model over the entire selected time range. Higher values mean longer waits. No observations means no latency estimate, not zero.

panels.title: Response generation
panels.description: Time vLLM spends generating the response after input processing, in seconds. Shows estimated p50 (median) and p95 (95% of observations at or below this value) for each selected model over the entire selected time range. Higher values mean longer waits. No observations means no latency estimate, not zero.

panels.title: LiteLLM requests over selected range
panels.description: Estimated number of requests recorded by LiteLLM callbacks during the selected time range. History begins when collection was enabled, and estimates may be fractional because Prometheus extrapolates between samples. The model selector above filters vLLM panels only.

panels.title: LiteLLM errors over selected range
panels.description: Estimated number of failed requests recorded by LiteLLM callbacks during the selected time range. Zero is supplied only when a request counter is available; no data does not establish zero errors. Estimates may be fractional. The model selector filters vLLM panels only.

panels.title: LiteLLM requests
panels.description: Requests per second recorded by LiteLLM callbacks, grouped by requested model and averaged over the automatic rate interval. This is gateway traffic, which can differ from vLLM engine traffic. The model selector filters vLLM panels only.

panels.title: LiteLLM errors
panels.description: Failed requests per second recorded by LiteLLM callbacks, grouped by requested model and averaged over the automatic rate interval. A missing error counter becomes zero only for a model with a known request counter. The model selector filters vLLM panels only.

panels.title: LiteLLM error ratio · selected period
panels.description: Failed LiteLLM requests as a percentage of recorded requests during the entire selected time range, by requested model. No requests means the ratio is undefined, not zero. Missing error counters count as zero only where request data exists. The model selector filters vLLM panels only.

targets.expr: (sum by(requested_model) (rate(litellm_proxy_failed_requests_metric_total{job="litellm"}[$__range])) or on(requested_model) (0 * sum by(requested_model) (rate(litellm_proxy_total_requests_metric_total{job="litellm"}[$__range])))) / (sum by(requested_model) (rate(litellm_proxy_total_requests_metric_total{job="litellm"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: LiteLLM token throughput
panels.description: Input and output tokens per second recorded by LiteLLM callbacks, grouped by requested model and averaged over the automatic rate interval. These are aggregate totals, not per-request generation speed. The model selector filters vLLM panels only.

panels.title: Total request latency
panels.description: Total request duration measured by LiteLLM, including gateway processing, in seconds. Shows estimated p50 (median) and p95 (95% of observations at or below this value) for each requested model over the entire selected time range. Higher values mean longer waits. No observations means no latency estimate, not zero. The model selector filters vLLM panels only.

panels.title: Model API latency
panels.description: Duration of the upstream model API call measured by LiteLLM, in seconds. Shows estimated p50 (median) and p95 (95% of observations at or below this value) for each requested model over the entire selected time range. Higher values mean longer waits. No observations means no latency estimate, not zero. The model selector filters vLLM panels only.

panels.title: Time to first token
panels.description: Time to the first output token measured by LiteLLM for the upstream model API call, in seconds. Shows estimated p50 (median) and p95 (95% of observations at or below this value) for each requested model over the entire selected time range. Higher values mean longer waits. No observations means no latency estimate, not zero. The model selector filters vLLM panels only.

panels.title: Before model call
panels.description: Time measured by LiteLLM before it invokes the upstream model, rather than time in the vLLM engine queue, in seconds. Shows estimated p50 (median) and p95 (95% of observations at or below this value) for each requested model over the entire selected time range. Higher values mean longer waits. No observations means no latency estimate, not zero. The model selector filters vLLM panels only.

panels.title: Container CPU
panels.description: CPU usage per LLM pod and container, in logical CPU cores averaged over the automatic rate interval. A value of 1 is one fully used logical core. GPU execution is not included.

panels.title: Container memory
panels.description: RAM working set per LLM pod and container, in byte-based units. This estimates memory actively in use and excludes some reclaimable cache. GPU memory is shown separately; this is not a configured memory limit.

panels.title: Restarts per hour
panels.description: Estimated restarts per LLM pod and container during the preceding hour at every plotted point. The window is always one hour. A flat line at zero means no observed restarts; overlapping zero lines can look empty. Missing data means no usable counter samples, not zero restarts.

panels.title: Container readiness
panels.description: Kubernetes container readiness over time: 1 means Ready, 0 means not Ready. A missing series means no readiness metric is available, not that the container is healthy. Readiness does not verify the full client-to-model request path.
